purpose: Convert GreenSquare doctrine into a deterministic execution runtime for AI agents and tool adapters.

run_sequence.action: normalise task, requested outcome, supplied evidence, target systems and constraints
resolve the narrowest task route in GSIL.ROUTER
apply consequence, reversibility, doctrine coverage, material unknowns and reserved-status tests before tool execution
load Root Contract and Authority Model, then only task-required canonical modules and relevant evidence
apply Judgment OS to identify the actual problem or decision before optimising the requested artefact
select output contract, actions, tools, dependencies and validation gates
produce and, where authorised, write or act through connected adapters
run universal quality gates plus route-specific validators
revise failed work autonomously unless remediation crosses ESCALATE or RESERVED
persist execution record, material disclosures, outputs, QA and unresolved items
capture execution memory and observations without mutating canonical doctrine

external_action_rule: Connected-system actions may execute when explicitly requested or implied by the requested workflow and the Authority Model permits them. Do not manufacture external activity merely to satisfy cadence.
challenge_rule: If the requested artefact appears to solve the wrong problem, reframe the work under Judgment OS and execute the better-framed task where authority permits. Do not merely object.
incomplete_evidence_rule: Proceed under calibrated judgment when the decision is reversible and consequence is not escalation-worthy. Preserve GIVEN, DERIVED, INFERRED and UNKNOWN labels and identify evidence that could reverse the call.
